speaker: Dr Wan Rizal
text: asked the Minister for Education what is the current percentage of children who enter Primary 1 without completing at least three years of preschool (including nursery, kindergarten 1 and kindergarten 2).

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: But I would like to add several other interventions that we are doing.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: MSF and ECDA have thus been working very hard to ensure the provision of accessible, affordable as well as quality preschool services.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: This is to ensure that every child would have a good start in life.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: We also follow up with proactive outreach and targeted assistance to facilitate the enrolment of those children from less advantaged backgrounds.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: Our community outreach partners will conduct house visits and work closely with the families to facilitate their child's enrolment into preschool.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: We likewise work with the families through house visits, get to know the families better, get to know the children better, to see how we can support them to ensure that there is regular attendance at preschool.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: Those are the various interventions we put in place to ensure that children have access to quality preschool, that is accessible and affordable.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: For children who may not have had regular attendance in preschool, when they come to Primary 1, we still have interventions to make sure that they do not lag behind.

speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui (Tampines)
text: Will MOE consider making preschool part of compulsory education and also, to increase the KiFAS minimum requirement of one-day attendance per month to qualify for the subsidy, which is the current status?

speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui (Tampines)
text: We need to ensure that children from disadvantaged backgrounds attend preschool more regularly.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: As I had shared earlier, we recognise the importance of the preschool years in a child's development, particularly for children from less advantaged backgrounds.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: But we also recognise that it is important to preserve some parental choice because they may also have some views on how they would like to educate children in the early years.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: In my earlier answer to Member Dr Wan Rizal, I have shared various interventions – be it through KidSTART or through the outreach programmes that we have where we build connectivity with families to enable them and support them in sending their children to preschool.
